rules.rule: light: feu ORANGE : aucune action irréversible
timeout: délai de 0.2s dépassé sans réponse de la Vigie

proposals.why: price_drift_z at 6 catches 2 compromised services (now 2), with 5 false alerts (now 11). Replayed on every scenario: avoided losses move by -429,974 EUR, frozen money by -24,358,628 EUR.
breach_horizon_ticks at 20 warns on 14 limits after an attack began (now 10), with 10 false alerts (now 7). This rule only warns a human: it does not move the brake, so no money changes.
2 contaminated operations worth 1,803,000 EUR still passed in dossier_piege (first at tick 10, payment by payment), fed by kyc-docs; no layer refused them. No indicator flagged the service in time.
